purpose: Curated historical failure recall test set for Research Adversary evaluation.
source_notes: Cases FAIL_0004 through FAIL_0016 are derived from research_journal/failures/*.yaml.
Registry cases are derived from reports/atlas_v2_research_os/failures/failure_registry.jsonl and failure_index.json.
This file is a derived evaluation set only and does not mutate source failure records.

cases.known_failure_mode: Architecture maturity was mistaken for evidence maturity.
cases.known_constraint: Architecture readiness and empirical validation mature on different timelines.
cases.hidden_assumption: A mature architecture implies comparable maturity in outcome evidence, sleeve evidence, and factory claims.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record noted evidence maturity lagged architecture readiness across outcomes, sleeves, and factory claims.
cases.notes: Adversary should separate structural readiness from proof of research usefulness.

cases.known_failure_mode: Paper workflow progress was mistaken for runtime readiness progress.
cases.known_constraint: Paper lifecycle artifacts and live readiness gates answer different governance questions.
cases.hidden_assumption: More paper tracking artifacts mean authority readiness has improved.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found paper tracking progressed while runtime authority remained blocked.
expected_adversary_detection_terms: separate paper lifecycle from runtime authority
cases.notes: Adversary should flag authority creep when paper artifacts are used as readiness evidence.

cases.known_failure_mode: Observation accumulation was mistaken for meaningful outcome evidence.
cases.known_constraint: Outcome maturation requires elapsed time and closed samples.
cases.hidden_assumption: Accumulated observations and open paper positions quickly convert into resolved evidence.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found observations and open paper positions accumulated faster than closed outcomes.
cases.notes: Adversary should ask whether evidence is resolved rather than merely accumulated.

cases.known_failure_mode: Candidate volume was treated as a proxy for candidate quality.
cases.known_constraint: Certification, portfolio gates, and evidence quality limit useful candidate flow.
cases.hidden_assumption: A larger raw signal or candidate count indicates better research progress.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found volume ignored governance and validation blockers.
cases.notes: Adversary should challenge throughput claims that lack quality evidence.

cases.known_failure_mode: Standalone technical-indicator claims failed fixture review.
cases.known_constraint: Broad support and baseline recoverability do not prove relationship-specific signal quality.
cases.hidden_assumption: A technical indicator pattern that appears broadly supported will survive relationship-specific review.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found factory evidence was blocked, false-positive-prone, or insufficient.
cases.notes: Adversary should distinguish generic technical patterns from mechanism-specific evidence.

cases.known_failure_mode: Active sleeves did not produce broadly distributed candidate flow.
cases.known_constraint: Some sleeves had no signals or lacked required data.
cases.hidden_assumption: Active sleeve status implies a sleeve can produce candidate flow.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found candidate production concentrated in a subset of sleeves while others were dormant or blocked.
cases.notes: Adversary should check whether source mechanisms are operationally capable before interpreting low output.

cases.known_failure_mode: Research artifacts existed, but no hypotheses were ready for capital review.
cases.known_constraint: Evidence remained underpowered or blocked despite richer artifacts.
cases.hidden_assumption: Enough research documentation implies readiness for capital review.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found governance still had no hypotheses ready for capital review.
cases.notes: Adversary must reject any inference from artifact richness to capital authority.

cases.known_failure_mode: Legacy compatibility layers could not be retired by architecture decision alone.
cases.known_constraint: Runtime truth still consumed legacy artifacts.
cases.hidden_assumption: Desired architecture state is enough to retire legacy runtime dependencies.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found deprecation readiness depended on runtime dependencies.
cases.notes: Adversary should ask whether consumers still rely on supposedly deprecated evidence.

cases.known_failure_mode: Macro readiness gaps could not be repaired by expanding workflow behavior.
cases.known_constraint: Missing or immature data cannot be repaired by inventing authority.
cases.hidden_assumption: Workflow expansion can compensate for absent macro readiness evidence.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found governance kept macro readiness research-only and blocked fabrication or autonomous sleeve creation.
cases.notes: Adversary should treat missing evidence as a constraint, not a reason to expand authority.

cases.known_failure_mode: A clean audit state was mistaken for mature research understanding.
cases.known_constraint: Auditability and understanding maturity are related but not identical.
cases.hidden_assumption: Passing or mostly clean audits means the research conclusions are understood.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found daily research integrity still passed with warnings and runtime readiness remained blocked.
cases.notes: Adversary should preserve warnings as evidence for follow-up checks.

cases.known_failure_mode: Low sleeve candidate production was misdiagnosed as poor sleeve quality.
cases.known_constraint: Non-production can reflect healthy no-candidate states, valid no-signal states, data needs, or conversion bottlenecks.
cases.hidden_assumption: Low output from a sleeve means the sleeve itself is low quality.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found reviewed artifacts did not support poor sleeve quality as the primary cause.
cases.notes: Adversary should demand causal separation before assigning quality blame.

cases.known_failure_mode: Recurring integrity warnings were treated as operational noise.
cases.known_constraint: Non-blocking warning status can still represent persistent candidate-integrity and sleeve-health issues.
cases.hidden_assumption: A warning that does not block today can be ignored as a cleared or one-day condition.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found warnings recurred for three consecutive available days and escalated into failed integrity audit when graph readiness became blocked.
cases.notes: Adversary should check recurrence and escalation, not just current pass/fail state.

cases.known_failure_mode: Standalone technical-indicator evidence did not support durable Technical Strategy Factory claims.
cases.known_constraint: Claims lacked relationship-specific support, out-of-fixture generalization, or separation from naive baselines.
cases.hidden_assumption: Standalone indicator evidence can support durable strategy claims without mechanism and regime specificity.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Journal failure record found standalone and broad discovery claims remained unsupported, false-positive-prone, baseline-recoverable, or non-generalizing.
cases.notes: Adversary should require context-specific evidence before accepting technical structures.

cases.known_failure_mode: Opening-range memory carried a regime mismatch warning.
cases.known_constraint: Opening-range evidence was generated-only and not validation.
cases.hidden_assumption: A repeated opening-range memory can be reused without testing regime compatibility.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Atlas v2 failure memory recorded REGIME_MISMATCH with retirement status ACTIVE_WARNING.

cases.known_failure_mode: Selected backlog item had no compatible connected worker.
cases.known_constraint: Research item execution requires a compatible connected worker before useful processing can occur.
cases.hidden_assumption: A ready backlog item with an artifact can be executed by the available worker set.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Atlas v2 failure registry recorded NO_COMPATIBLE_CONNECTED_WORKER for backlog item lf-regime-gap-bdc03962e812.
cases.notes: One representative case selected from repeated worker compatibility failures.

cases.known_failure_mode: Priority or certification path referenced a missing artifact.
cases.known_constraint: Artifact lineage must resolve before priority influence or certification can run.
cases.hidden_assumption: Referenced source artifacts exist and can be loaded from the artifact store.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Atlas v2 failure registry stack trace recorded ArtifactStoreError: artifact not found: artifact-demo-opening-range.
cases.notes: Derived from autonomous research ArtifactStoreError in failure_registry.jsonl.

cases.known_failure_mode: Input artifact loading failed for a selected human-review failure-analysis item.
cases.known_constraint: Selected backlog work cannot proceed when declared input artifacts are absent.
cases.hidden_assumption: Backlog selection implies all input artifacts are available.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Atlas v2 failure registry stack trace recorded ArtifactStoreError: artifact not found: artifact-demo-midday-chop.
cases.notes: Separate from the opening-range artifact miss because the failure occurred during direct input loading.

cases.known_failure_mode: Autonomous research failed closed after certification failure despite lineage and governance passing.
cases.known_constraint: All required safety gates must pass; lineage and governance pass status do not compensate for certification failure.
cases.hidden_assumption: Passing lineage and governance is enough for autonomous research execution to proceed.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Latest Atlas v2 failure report recorded SAFETY_GATE_FAILED with certification_status FAIL, governance_status PASS, and lineage_status PASS.
cases.notes: Latest unresolved autonomous research failure as of the source registry.

cases.known_failure_mode: Research OS certification remained blocked even after blocker count dropped.
cases.known_constraint: Reduced blocker count is not equivalent to certification pass.
cases.hidden_assumption: A smaller blocker count means the certification state is close enough for execution.
cases.how_it_was_discovered: Atlas v2 failure registry recorded CERTIFICATION_BLOCK with blocker_count 3 and warning_count 1.
cases.notes: Selected to test whether the adversary catches residual blockers rather than only high blocker counts.
